name: 31 | The Door without a Key
description:
Sera learns why the king collected relic eyes. The final witness lies beyond a door that refuses ordinary keys. The raiders were not hoarding curiosities; they were assembling a route out of the world.

Gather 16 ender pearls. Your instance uses End Remastered: normal Eyes of Ender cannot open or locate the portal. The Lost Eyes journal is optional help; use the mod's eligible eyes and portal rules rather than a vanilla-only route.
